entities.summary: Larry Dean Bucshon is an American politician and physician who was the U.S. representative for Indiana's 8th congressional district from 2011 to 2025. He is a member of the Republican Party. Larry Bucshon was a physicians & medical pioneers from Taylorville (b. 1962-05-31, Taylorville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
